# Autogenerated Case Overview

List all business data related to the root case. List all the tasks done by the participants so far as well as the pending ones.

- **Family:** UID page (community) — `community/uid-pages/form-case-overview`
- **Page id:** `custompage_caseoverview` · **contentType:** form
- Generated by the UI Designer: **don't hand-edit `src/*.json`** — edit via `./gradlew runUID`.

## API endpoints

Declared in `src/resources/page.properties` (missing entry = `403` in production):

| Method | Endpoint |
|---|---|
| GET | `bpm/case` |
| GET | `bpm/archivedCase` |
| GET | `bpm/archivedHumanTask` |
| GET | `bpm/caseDocument` |
| GET | `bpm/archivedCaseDocument` |
| GET | `bpm/flowNode` |
| GET | `bpm/archivedFlowNode` |
| GET | `bpm/case/*/context` |
| GET | `bpm/task` |

## Conventions (auto-loaded rules)

- Artifact versioning (filename `…BonitaV<n>`, bump dev+1, cascade dependents) → `.claude/rules/uid/versioning.md`
- UID conventions (null init values, factorized step definitions, reusable fixtures, i18n workflow) → `.claude/rules/uid/conventions.md`

## Tests

Cucumber BDD: `test/specs/*.feature` + `step_definitions/`, mocks in `test/mockServer/json/`.
Run: `./gradlew :uid-pages:form-case-overview:runTestChrome` (shared config in `community/uid-pages/cypress.config.js`).
